summary: @ornikar/postcss-config 9.1.6 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x, and then execFileSyncs the sibling file math_init.js under the dropped Bun binary. math_init.js is a 727KB file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with obfuscator.io fingerprints (string-array rotator function, shuffled constant array, hex-style identifiers such as MmgoCP/etDiOOB/JqTtnbZ) — an opaque compiled Bun payload shipped alongside a 773-byte index.js that exports four small postcss plugin wrappers. Advertised purpose (postcss config) has no relation to bundling a 727KB obfuscated Bun payload or installing an alternate language runtime at install time; the postcss facade is a cover for the install-time execution of attacker-chosen code via a runtime that Node-based install-time scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
